about.intro_content: Prof. Rui-Hua Xu is President of Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center (SYSUCC), Guangzhou, and a Professor in the Department of Medical Oncology, specialising in gastrointestinal (GI) medical oncology. He is also President of the Chinese Society of Clinical Oncology (CSCO) and Editor-in-Chief of Cancer Communications.
about.detailed_content: Prof. Xu completed a visiting associate professorship at MD Anderson Cancer Center, USA (2002–2005). He has led numerous global and domestic multi-centre clinical trials in GI cancer, including as Principal Investigator of the ESCORT-1st trial demonstrating survival benefit of camrelizumab added to chemotherapy in advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma, and trials evaluating neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy with sintilimab in rectal cancer. His research has developed real-time AI tools for detecting upper gastrointestinal cancer by endoscopy, published in The Lancet Oncology. He has published more than 200 peer-reviewed papers in journals including JAMA, Cell, BMJ, Cancer Cell, Nature Medicine and Lancet Oncology, and is recognised as a Highly Cited Researcher by Clarivate Analytics.

faq.section_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Prof. Rui-Hua Xu

items.question: Does Prof. Rui-Hua Xu accept international patients?
items.answer: CancerFax can coordinate medical report review and consultation support for international patients seeking an opinion related to gastrointestinal cancer at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center, subject to hospital availability and case acceptance.

items.question: What is Prof. Xu's area of specialisation?
items.answer: Prof. Xu specialises in gastrointestinal medical oncology, including novel drug development and individualized treatment for esophageal, gastric and colorectal cancer.

items.question: How can I request a consultation or second opinion?
items.answer: Submit your medical reports through CancerFax. The CancerFax team reviews the documents, prepares the case for submission, and coordinates next steps with SYSUCC's International Medical Center, subject to availability.

items.question: What is Prof. Xu's role at SYSUCC?
items.answer: Prof. Xu has served as President of Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center since 2014, alongside his clinical and research practice in the Department of Medical Oncology.

items.question: Has Prof. Xu led any landmark cancer trials?
items.answer: Yes. Prof. Xu was Principal Investigator of the ESCORT-1st trial, which showed that adding camrelizumab to chemotherapy improves survival in advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma, and has led trials on rectal cancer immunotherapy and AI-assisted GI cancer detection.
